headlines.title: 国家税务总局：上半年全国税收收入超过10万亿元，同比增长4.9%
headlines.summary: 国家税务总局局长胡静林7月28日在国新办新闻发布会上介绍，今年上半年，税务部门累计征收税费收入16.7万亿元。其中，税收收入超过10万亿元（不含海关代征进口增值税、消费税和关税、船舶吨税，未扣除出口退税），同比增长4.9%。

headlines.summary_en: SAT Administration head Hu Jinglin said at a July 28 press conference that the tax department collected a total of 16.7 trillion yuan in taxes and fees in the first half of this year, with tax revenue exceeding 10 trillion yuan, up 4.9% year-on-year.

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...
headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现为香港写字楼资产的最大非本地买家
headlines.summary_zh: 根据高力国际的数据，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处于低位，未来几个月来自新加坡的需求可能保持稳定。

headlines.title: 深圳上半年跨境人民币结算同比增37.9% FT账户交易增超9成
headlines.summary: 7月28日上午，记者在中国人民银行深圳市分行、国家外汇管理局深圳市分局2026年上半年新闻发布会上获悉，今年上半年，深圳跨境人民币结算规模达3.8万亿元，同比增长37.9%，规模稳居全国第三。其中，货物贸易项下人民币使用水平显著提升。上半年，深圳货物贸易跨境人民币收支合计8364亿元，同比增长50.2%，占本外币收支比重同比提升近5个百分点至31%，充分发挥本币结算优势，助力外贸企业减轻汇率波动影响，降低结算成本，提高交易效率。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen H1 cross-border RMB settlement up 37.9% YoY, FT account transactions up over 90%
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, the Shenzhen branch of the PBOC and SAFE reported that Shenzhen cross-border RMB settlement volume reached 3.8 trillion yuan in H1 2026, up 37.9% YoY, third nationally. headlines.title: 上半年税务部门累计征收税费收入16.7万亿元
headlines.summary: 今天上午，国务院新闻办举行新闻发布会。国家税务总局相关负责人介绍，今年上半年，税务部门累计征收税费收入16.7万亿元。其中，税收收入超过10万亿元，同比增长4.9%。这主要得益于经济运行总体平稳向好，与税收收入密切相关的PPI持续回升，以及部分新兴领域和重点行业发展势头强劲。同时，社会保险费收入完成4.5万亿元，非税收入完成1.8万亿元，国家的财力保障不断夯实。（央视新闻）

headlines.summary_en: At a press conference held by the State Council Information Office this morning, the SAT reported that the tax department collected 16.7 trillion yuan in taxes and fees in H1, with tax revenue over 10 trillion yuan, up 4.9% YoY, driven by a stable economic recovery, rising PPI, and strong growth in emerging sectors. Social insurance fee revenue reached 4.5 trillion yuan, and non-tax revenue 1.8 trillion yuan, strengthening fiscal capacity.

headlines.title_en: China's State Taxation Administration: H1 market entity activity further improves
headlines.summary_en: SAT head Hu Jinglin noted that tax data shows active business entities in China rose 20.2% YoY in H1, with taxable filing entities up 10%. High-tech and digital economy core industry sales revenue grew 15% and 8.7% YoY respectively, with their shares of total corporate sales revenue up 1.7 and 1.1 percentage points. High-tech manufacturing and digital product services profits rose 29.2% and 64.4% YoY. Foreign-invested taxpaying entities increased 10.9%, and foreign enterprises' declared total profits grew 4.5% YoY.

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stock movers: Non-ferrous metal stocks broadly weaker on risk-off sentiment and caution ahead of Fed meeting
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong-listed non-ferrous metals stocks are broadly weak, with Ganfeng Lithium down nearly 5%, Tianqi Lithium over 3%, Aluminum Corp of China and JL Mag down 2.6%, and Lingbao Gold, CNMC, Zijin Gold International, MMG, CMOC, and Jiangxi Copper down over 2%, followed by Chifeng Gold, China Hongqiao, and Zijin Mining. Market sentiment has eased amid signs of a phase in US-Iran tensions. Shanghai gold and silver futures closed slightly lower, pressuring precious metals. The non-ferrous sector faces pressure from reduced safe-haven demand. Markets are facing a highly uncertain Fed rate decision this week.

headlines.title: 分析师：澳洲联储鹰派表态并不意外
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月28日讯，澳洲联储主席布洛克在讲话中表示，未来进一步加息的可能性仍然存在。她指出，当前通胀水平仍然过高，同时强调央行希望避免市场形成对物价持续上涨的固化预期。分析师JamesGlynn指出，鉴于中东紧张局势再次升级，澳洲联储释放鹰派信号并不令人意外。再次出现燃料价格冲击的风险较高，而从当前情况来看，代价最小的政策路径可能是进一步提高利率。

headlines.title_en: Analysts: RBA hawkish stance not surprising
headlines.summary_en: RBA Governor Bullock said in a speech on July 28 that further rate hikes remain possible, citing still-high inflation and a desire to avoid entrenching price expectations. Analyst JamesGlynn noted that with rising Middle East tensions, the hawkish signal is unsurprising, as fuel price shock risks are high, and the least costly policy path may be further rate increases.

headlines.title: 国家税务总局：税收数据显示上半年新质生产力发展势头强劲
headlines.summary: 今天上午国务院新闻办举行新闻发布会。国家税务总局相关负责人介绍，上半年工业企业销售收入持续提升，新质生产力发展势头强劲，创新动能加速成长。国家税务总局局长胡静林表示，今年上半年，仅装备制造业，信息传输、软件和信息技术服务业，科技服务业这三个与新质生产力紧密相关的行业销售收入占全部企业销售收入的比重就达23.5%，较上年同期提高2.2个百分点，且呈逐年快速上升势头。如考虑其他新兴行业和传统产业转型升级，新质生产力相关产业占比会更高。（央视新闻）
headlines.title_zh: 国家税务总局：税收数据显示上半年新质生产力发展势头强劲
headlines.summary_zh: 今天上午国务院新闻办举行新闻发布会。国家税务总局相关负责人介绍，上半年工业企业销售收入持续提升，新质生产力发展势头强劲，创新动能加速成长。国家税务总局局长胡静林表示，今年上半年，仅装备制造业，信息传输、软件和信息技术服务业，科技服务业这三个与新质生产力紧密相关的行业销售收入占全部企业销售收入的比重就达23.5%，较上年同期提高2.2个百分点，且呈逐年快速上升势头。如考虑其他新兴行业和传统产业转型升级，新质生产力相关产业占比会更高。（央视新闻）
headlines.title_en: China's State Taxation Administration: Tax data shows strong H1 momentum in new quality productive forces
headlines.summary_en: At a press conference this morning, the SAT reported that industrial enterprises' sales revenue continued to rise in H1, new quality productive forces showed strong momentum, and innovation energy accelerated. SAT head Hu Jinglin said that in H1, revenue from equipment manufacturing, IT services, and technology services—closely tied to new quality productive forces—accounted for 23.5% of total corporate sales, up 2.2 percentage points YoY, with a rapid annual increase. Including other emerging industries and traditional industry upgrades, the share would be higher.

headlines.title_en: July 28 midday close: ChiNext falls over 5% in half-day session, consumer staples buck trend to rise
headlines.summary_en: Markets saw volatile adjustments early in the session, with three major indices falling. Consumer stocks like baijiu and dairy products rose, with Golden Seed, Yimin Food, and Dongbai Group hitting daily limits. Brain-computer interface concept extended gains, with Innovation Medical, Hainan Haiyao, and Nanjing Panda all hitting consecutive daily limits. Lithography machine concept stocks rose then fell, with companies like Browave, Zhangjiang Hi-Tech, and Haili Stock hitting limits. On the downside, computing hardware stocks fell, with Cambridge Technology hitting limit down, and Zhongji Innolight and Eoptolink falling over 10%; semiconductor stocks fell, with GigaDevice hitting limit down, and Puyuan and Beijing Junzheng falling over 10%. Individual stocks were mixed, with half-day turnover at 1.34 trillion yuan.

headlines.title_en: A-share midday review: ChiNext opened lower and fell 5.37%, with AI hardware leading the declines.
headlines.summary_en: By midday break, Shanghai Composite down 0.98%, Shenzhen Component down 3.42%, ChiNext down 5.37%, BeiBei 50 up 0.55%. Total turnover of three markets at 1.3365 trillion yuan, shrinking 20.5 billion yuan from previous day. Over 2,500 stocks fall across market. Sector themes: dairy, baijiu, brain-computer interface gain most; components, semiconductors, CPO concepts lag most. Market: dairy sector continues rising, Yiming Food hits limit up, Pinwo Food up over 15%, Wancheng Group, Huanlejia, Xinruye, Qishi Dairy, Qiaqia Food follow. Baijiu sector fluctuates higher, Golden Seed Wine hits limit up, Huangtai Wine, Jinshiyuan, Yingjia Gongjiu, Gujing Gongjiu, Luzhou Laojiao follow. Brain-computer interface stays strong, Saili Medical, Innovation Medical, Hainan Haiyao, Nanjing Panda hit 2 consecutive limit-ups, Kelan Software, Yanshan Technology hit limit-up, Beiyikang, Xiangyu Medical
